title: Checkpoint restore rewrites every entry as 0644 regular file, dropping exec bits and symlinks
notes: Imported by S-080 (D-015-04 amended) from the 2026-09-29 re-check: verdict fixed in 961891ab (shipped in v1.0.0-rc.10). Regression test restore_preserves_exec_bit_and_symlinks at :1486. Guard resolved through its runner on 2026-09-29. Status stays fixed, not verified, until a live re-run on a rebuilt release records evidence.
